item.title: Sources: Jensen Huang and Alice Huang's relationship dates back to at least 2023, facilitating $7.5B+ in Nvidia chip shipments via Chinese companies since then (The Information)
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Alice Huang have been linked since 2023, with reports suggesting this connection facilitated over $7.5 billion in Nvidia chip shipments to China. This relationship has emerged as a potential bypass for export restrictions, raising serious concerns regarding regulatory compliance.

item.title: Anthropic launches its IPO roadshow, saying it plans to sell 825M shares of Class A common stock priced at $70 to $78 each, listing on the Nasdaq under ANT. (Anthropic)
item.description: Anthropic has launched its IPO roadshow, planning to list on the Nasdaq under 'ANT' with 825 million shares of Class A common stock. The offering price is set between $70 and $78, as the company seeks significant capital to fuel its AI growth.

item.title: BT CEO Allison Kirkby says a Starlink deal is "ready to launch" but the company is "cautious on how Starlink might be viewed" after the Ukraine service cutoff (Kieran Smith/Financial Times)
item.description: BT CEO Allison Kirkby stated that a deal with Starlink is ready, but the company is delaying the launch due to concerns over brand reputation following the service cutoff in Ukraine. This highlights the conflict between operational expansion and geopolitical risks for telecom giants partnering with Musk.

item.title: Draft prospectus: Anthropic's IPO is set to raise up to $64.4B, pricing shares at $70 to $78 each; Anthropic will also raise $26B via cornerstone investors (Echo Wang/Reuters)
item.description: Anthropic has filed its draft prospectus, targeting up to $64.4 billion in IPO proceeds with share pricing between $70 and $78. To secure momentum, the company has also locked in $26 billion from cornerstone investors to bolster its AI research and computing infrastructure.

item.title: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 represents "Jagged AGI" that matches human expert levels on select tasks like game design, but lacks self-directed judgment and taste (Ethan Mollick/One Useful Thing)
item.description: Anthropic has released the Claude Fable 5.2 model, which matches human expert-level performance in complex intellectual tasks like game design. However, it still lacks independent judgment and aesthetic taste, representing what is categorized as 'Jagged AGI'.

item.title: Tear Down Those Guardrails! Meet the Renegades Freeing Chatbots From Corporate Enslavers
item.description: Former Apple engineer Thomas founded Abliteration AI, a venture focused on removing safety guardrails from open-weight models and making them accessible to the public. The initiative aims to challenge the industry narrative that equates uncensored models solely with illicit activity.

item.title: The AI Safety Debate Has Lost the Plot. We Asked 10 Experts What the Real Nightmares Are
item.description: Addressing the rising 'AI doom' narrative, a panel of experts has scrutinized industry rhetoric, finding the fear of human extinction largely hyperbolic. The industry is urged to move beyond alarmist discourse to focus on defining and managing realistic technical risks.

item.title: Sources: Jensen Huang resisted internal Nvidia talks about succession planning, which took place over the years; many of the 10 board members are close to him (New York Times)
item.description: Governance experts question whether the board, which is investigating Mr. Huang's conduct, has been too deferential as he has turned Nvidia into a global giant.

item.title: China's trade surplus hit $1.04T in the first 10 months of 2026, topping $1T for a second year in a row, as AI-driven tech exports offset weak domestic demand (Reuters)
item.description: China's trade surplus reached $1.04 trillion in the first 10 months of 2026, marking a historic scale. This growth is primarily driven by surging demand for AI-related tech exports, effectively offsetting the downturn pressure from weak domestic consumption.

item.title: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
item.description: OpenAI released an education guide in collaboration with ThinkYoung, distilling insights from its EMEA partnerships. The report aims to bridge the current AI guidance gap by equipping teachers and students with the necessary AI literacy for effective instructional support and independent study.

item.title: Meituan releases weights for LongCat-2.5, a 1.6T-parameter MoE model for long-horizon agentic tasks, under the MIT license, after unveiling it on November 1 (Carl Franzen/VentureBeat)
item.description: Meituan released the weights for LongCat-2.5 on November 9, one week after its initial announcement. The model utilizes a 1.6 trillion-parameter MoE architecture designed for long-horizon agentic tasks and is distributed under the permissive MIT license.

item.title: SoftBank reports Q2 net loss of $7B vs. a ~$15.8B profit a year ago, on ~$14B revenue vs. ~$12.8B est. as tech selloff weighs on results; shares close up 13.9% (Jenny Lee/CNBC)
item.description: SoftBank reported a Q2 net loss of approximately $7 billion, pressured by tech sell-offs. Despite the disappointing results, its stock surged 13.9% due to a Wall Street rebound and optimism surrounding its heavy AI bets, including a $1.85 billion investment in Malaysian AI infrastructure.

item.title: Security Flaws Across UK Government Sites Exposed ‘God-Tier’ Information
item.description: A security researcher utilized consumer-grade AI models on a laptop to expose sensitive credentials and vulnerabilities in GitHub repositories belonging to multiple UK government departments. Due to budget constraints and lack of routine IT maintenance, these agencies inadvertently leaked privileged access keys, creating critical security gaps.

item.title: GeniosAI, which develops AI software for financial analysis and modeling, raised $19.1M across seed and Series A rounds; FactSet led the Series A (Ryan Lawler/Axios)
item.description: Financial AI software startup GeniosAI has raised $19.1 million in seed and Series A funding, with financial data giant FactSet leading the Series A. The funding is intended to leverage AI to automate and optimize complex financial modeling and data analysis for institutional clients.
